headline: Low current Tail after NQ repairs to mid-range; extreme macro and geopolitical Stress persists
body: Delayed NQ was 29,606.25 with a reported 29,477.75-29,739.00 session range, placing it almost exactly at mid-range after a substantial rebound from the low.
